protocol.name: D9c explicit generic interaction-event pilot
protocol.purpose: test whether identifiable recent interaction events recover response specificity better than snapshot or opaque temporal history
protocol.scope: the same 218 fit groups and five episode-blocked folds as D9b; prior inspected TRAIN, DEV, and TEST remain closed

data.normalization: reuse each D9b fold's current-state, future-action, and response normalizers; fit transition-delta and executed-control input normalizers on all non-validation histories

per_transition: normalized signed change in the first 45 continuous pose/velocity channels
absolute continuous change divided by the same scale
12 contact flags before and after the transition
event_representation.pooling: shared event MLP followed by mean, maximum, and latest-event pooling
event_representation.scene_context: fuse event pools with the unchanged normalized current-state D9b encoding
event_representation.semantics: no named modes, task goal, failure label, alarm target, Jenga geometry, or task-specific object role

optimization.sampling: deterministic uniform group sampling without replacement; no class balancing
optimization.execution: one sequential GPU run at a time

decision.pass: replicate seeds 2 and 3 on the same fit-only folds before opening any held-out split
decision.fail: do not add event complexity or tune on these folds; reconsider continuous curve prediction as the learned-model interface
